provenance: Derived from pot_all causal failures where code computed correlations but printed blank, vague, or mis-shaped conclusions.

semantic_labels.label: causal.correlation_evidence_shape
semantic_labels.description: State causal-style conclusion first and include correlation coefficient evidence.

scope.observed_error: causal answers missed conclusion-first coefficient evidence or comparative causal factor

payload.content: For causal-analysis questions, print a concise conclusion first (`Yes`, `No`, or the strongest influencing factor), then include the key correlation coefficient evidence. For comparative causal questions, compare absolute coefficients and name the strongest factor.

rationale: Targets causal analysis answer-shape failures and comparative coefficient questions.
